text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Late December. To prepare for the Arima 
Kinen, we held a winter training camp for 
a few days.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
The Symboli household has always 
patronized our place. Sirius-chan, too, 
has been coming here often with trainers 
since way back...

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you used to be so small, and now 
look how splendid you've become!

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Man, the Japan Cup! That was seriously 
incredible, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Madame. While I appreciate the 
compliment, something smells like it's 
burning underneath.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Oh dear, is that the turkey!? Come 
on, that was supposed to be my special 
treat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Tonight, through the owner's 
generous hospitality, we get to enjoy a 
Christmas dinner!

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, a bit early, but Merry 
Christmas! And, Sirius-chan, good luck in 
the 'Arima Kinen'~!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I ain't gonna lose.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Confident, aren't you? But it's the Arima 
Kinen, you know? Rudolf-chan is running in 
it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's tons of folks like that all over 
the world. Ain't got time to be freaked 
out.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose you're right. —Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
No matter how big you get, Sirius-chan, at 
your core, you really haven't changed a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
I've been telling you all along, haven't 
I? That I'm going to be the brightest star 
in the universe.

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
You've made it all the way here without 
wavering in the slightest, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Nah, I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Phew... I almost ate way too much.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Still, totally unshakeable, huh—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
..."Lonely" doesn't even begin to cover 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(............ Looking back now, that was 
quite pathetic.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(I lost sight of my own goal, got 
obsessed, and didn't even care to listen 
to my Trainer's voice.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Ungainly, ridiculous, fragile―― If I were 
the Trainer, I'd have cut them loose 
without hesitation.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(I'm amazed she never gave up on me after 
that.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...No, far from abandoning them, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius should be the star that shines the 
brightest!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Why did you hold on to her so dearly back 
then?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Even collapsing on the beach, why was I 
so desperately driven to protect it?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(A word like "foolishly honest"— ain't 
nearly enough to understand it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our Christmas dinner, we 
went on a walk to a nearby hill to digest 
our food.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was colder than I expected... but the 
view is clearer than at the academy, and 
the stars are so visible. As I gazed at 
the sky for a while—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Stargazing, huh? Well ain't you doing 
something fancy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even finish saying "S—", 
something was thrown right into my face 
with a soft thud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfolding it―― it turned out to be the 
scarf she always uses.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Keep it on. It'd be a pain if you caught a 
cold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A flash of white flits across the corner 
of my vision.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... They say it's going to snow tonight.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Once you're tired of looking, get yourself 
right back here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I frantically chase after Sirius Symboli, 
who has already started walking away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The scarf I'd hastily wrapped around 
myself was only faintly warm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was colder than I expected... but the 
view is clearer than at the academy, and 
the stars are so visible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had looked into it once in the past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius" is the brightest star in the 
night sky. With twice the mass of the Sun 
and 25 times its luminosity, it forms one 
vertex of the Winter Triangle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, they have been 
worshipped across all nations, and are 
said to have even played a role in guiding 
humanity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relying on my memory, I look up toward 
where it seemed to be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something was draped over my shoulders. It 
was a large stole, carrying the faint, 
gentle scent of Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll lend it to you, put it on.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Stargazing, huh? Quite the 
sophisticated hobby.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Not a bad mindset. ...See that one? The 
pale blue first-magnitude star. You know 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I look up at the place she's pointing to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A sharp light that seemed ready to scorch 
the winter sky— Sirius recognized it in an 
instant."
choice_data_list:
...It's a star that suits your name 
perfectly.

...That star is a perfect match for your 
name.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Is that some new kind of 
pickup line?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I murmur to myself that his brilliant, 
radiant figure, and the overwhelming power 
that pulls everyone along with it, is 
quintessentially Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Staying by their side, you must have seen 
both the sweet and the bitter. Can you 
still say that with absolute certainty?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The beauty of Sirius shining in the 
celestial sphere is something one could 
never tire of—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, I don't get it. She really is 
unnatural.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the fluttering snow brought us back 
to our senses, the two of us stood gazing 
at it for quite some time.
